## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger, the old behavior and the resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue if available.

## Scope

Name affected editions/providers and explain any settings, compatibility or migration implications.

## Validation

List only builds/checks actually performed and their results. State whether tests or live provider checks were
requested and performed. Build success does not establish authentication or Store approval.

## Documentation and limitations

Link updated guides/changelog entries and describe unresolved limitations. Do not attach credentials, private
provider data, generated packages or personal IDE settings.
